title: helm-private-values-init-hooks-rollback-fix
author: Asha Patel
description: Fixes a regression in Helm init hook ordering and values schema validation that caused rollback failures during Private chart upgrades. Context: recent schema tightening (PR 69501) surfaced an ordering edge case where initJobs annotated as hooks could run after post-upgrade hooks in some Helm versions, leaving secrets/unseal steps incomplete. This PR introduces a deterministic hook weight ordering, updates the values.schema.json to allow both legacy and strict encryption configs, and adds an integration test for upgrade+rollback. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce failure in perf environment - [x] Build reproducible helm chart release - [x] Add test harness for in-cluster upgrade+rollback - [x] Add migration note in chart README - [x] Update values.schema.json with compatibility rules - [x] CI green on helm-lint and integration-suite Motivation: customers using Redwood Private on constrained K8s clusters saw failed rollbacks after upgrading the installer; this gave us a Sev2 during a recent upgrade exercise. The fix must be backwards compatible with existing values and work across Helm 3.7-3.11. Summary of changes: - Deterministic hook weight assignment for initJobs and upgrade hooks (templates/hooks/_hook_helpers.tpl) - Values schema relaxed to accept legacy kms/encryption formats while validating required fields for new installs (values.schema.json) - Add explicit pre-upgrade and post-upgrade hook naming and weights in init-job templates - Add smoke integration test that performs helm upgrade then rollback and asserts pod init job completed and secrets unsealed - README and migration notes for chart operators Rollout: merged to main via squash merge after CI green and 2 approvals. Backports: none (will open a release branch PR if needed).
commits: Add deterministic hook weight helper and use in init job templates
Relax values.schema.json to allow legacy kms string and structured kms object
Add integration test upgrade-rollback in perf-canary and chart README migration note
Fix lint and re-run helm unit tests

ci_details: Initial CI run: helm-lint failed due to strict schema; fixed schema and re-run. Integration-suite (perf-canary) passed: upgrade_rollback_test.sh succeeded on k8s 1.24 and 1.26 nodes. All checks green before merge.
release_notes: Fix Helm init hook ordering to ensure deterministic upgrade+rollback behavior; values.schema.json updated for kms/encryption compatibility. Operators should read chart README migration note.
notes: This PR addresses an operational failure seen in the field. We intentionally preserved legacy values formats to avoid forcing mass operator changes; a follow-up will add a migration tool to help convert legacy kms strings to structured objects. If customers still encounter rollback failures, open SUP ticket with cluster details and helm version.
